data.text:
模板装配 SQL：
SELECT m.well_id AS 井号, w.block_name AS 区块, m.prod_date AS 日期, m.liquid_output AS 日产液量（方）
FROM agg.fct_daily_metering m
  JOIN agg.dim_well w ON w.well_id = m.well_id
  JOIN agg.dim_date d ON d.date = m.prod_date
WHERE m.prod_date >= '2026-09-29' AND m.prod_date < '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY m.prod_date, m.well_id
LIMIT 50
